title: ⚡ An Ongoing Cyberattack on an Energy Giant!
body: ⚡ An Ongoing Cyberattack on an Energy Giant!
Norwegian company Equinor, Europe’s largest supplier of natural gas, announced that the cyberattack on its systems is still ongoing two days after it was discovered.
Production is running normally, and there is so far no evidence of data being stolen or altered, and the attack does not appear to be specifically targeted at the company.
Simply put, the attackers are still inside the company’s systems and internal email is down, while the gas keeps flowing without interruption.
Do you trust major energy companies to protect themselves from attacks? What do you think?
